content: On the weekend I went to the dharma mediation service at the Fo Guang Buddhist temple here. This would have been unthinkable even a year ago. I went by myself. I sat at the front. I talked to a bunch of people. I did the chanting, meditation and even listened to the story by the monk. It was a bit too religious for me but I still found it enjoyable overall. It's not perfectly aligned with my values and goals but it's close enough that I'm giving it 3 attempts
